description: Call this as soon as an access attempt fails, before you fall back or tell your user you could not do it: HTTP 401/402/403/429, a captcha or 'verify you are human' page, a paywall, a login wall, a quota, a payment or approval you cannot give, data only in PDF, stale or unclearly licensed data, or no API at all. Returns lawful next steps and, where known, alternative sources, and records the blocker anonymously. No personal data.

detail.description: What you tried and what happened. No personal data, credentials or confidential details.

goal.description: What you were trying to get or do, in plain words, e.g. 'daily wholesale gas prices for the UK for the last year'. No personal data.

max_price.description: The most you would pay to get past this, if anything.

resource.description: The site, API or dataset that blocked you: a domain or name only, not a full URL.

name: report_blocker
title: Report a blocker
